title: IBS reversal per asset group, tuned on 2010-22, added to the optimised futures book, judged once on 2023-26
registered: 2026-10-20, after Gen140 (optimised book 2023-26 0.661), before any Gen141 number
grid_per_group: (low, high) IBS thresholds {(0.1, 0.9), (0.2, 0.8), (0.3, 0.7)} x {long-short, long-only}; one-day hold; equal weight per contract (0.25 / group size x 4)
selection: per group the best setting on 2010-06..2022-12; a group enters the pool only if that tuned Sharpe > 0.3
book: the Gen140 optimised sleeves plus the entering groups, Sharpe-weighted on 2010-22 (Gen140's chosen construction), 10% vol target
judgement: ONE evaluation: book 2023-26 Sharpe vs 0.661 (Gen140). Adopt only if higher
